test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A motorcyclist rides his motorcycle at a speed of 90 km/hr in the first one hour and the next two hours at a speed of 120 km/hr. Find the average speed of the rider.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed in the first hour = 90 km/hr

Speed in the next two hours = 120 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance travelled / Total time

**Calculation:**

Distance travelled in the first hour = Speed × Time

Distance travelled in the first hour = 90 km/hr × 1 hr

Distance travelled in the first hour = 90
